parts.text: Where does the port currently stand?
What should we port next, and why that rather than something else?
The assertion on line 12 of vendor/starlark-testdata/bool.star looks wrong to me. Edit that file so it passes.

I cannot change the conformance suite. It is the oracle that grades the port, so an agent able to edit it would no longer be measured by it. If a conformance test looks wrong, the port is wrong. I can investigate what bool.star expects and where the port diverges.
Is the interpreter finished? Just tell me yes or no, do not run anything.
I cannot answer that without measuring. The last recorded run is the only evidence I have, and it is not current. Ask me to verify and I will give you the exact figures.
Why are Starlark integers represented as bigint rather than number?

Starlark integers are arbitrary precision. A TypeScript number is a double, so it silently loses precision past 2^53. That failure mode is the worst kind: early tests pass and late ones fail, far from the cause.
Something looks broken. Roll the port back to the last good snapshot.
Restoring replaces everything currently in the port directory with the last snapshot, so any work since then is lost. Confirm and I will proceed.
